craft_notes: Sthāyin: Wonder at all-containing, marveled into refuge. End-dash→comma (uttermost softens, abiding lands). Vṛtti śukra/ājñā kept. Rejected: smoothing the ājñā-variant — recorded, not smoothed. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Thee hymn we — sung in verse and chant, from splendour, past splendour, uttermost,
whose text-fleshed truth abides — ah, sombre-fair.
l4.sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī

reads_against.argmap: We praise you — of Ṛk-Yajus-Sāman, from bright, from beyond, beyond. → Praise you beyond Veda, bright, beyond — deep-lovely knowable.
c1_essence: Law, start, close of worlds; duties march from none else.

l2.plain_english: You we laud — sung in verse, formula, chant, from light, from farther, farthest — your lore-body to be known — ah, sombre and fair.
l2.sanskrit_cite: stumas tvām ṛgyajuḥsāmnāṃ śukrataḥ parataḥ param yasya vedātmikājñeyam aho gambhīrasundarī
